activity.notes: Pyrrhus invaded Macedonia in 288 BCE and obtained a share of the Macedonian kingdom before Lysimachus forced him out around 285/284 BCE. ATLAS records 288-c.285 BCE as a separate Macedonian kingship rather than folding it into his Epirote reign.

sources.title: Tra Egitto, Macedonia e Sparta. Pirro, un monarca in Epiro — Persée review
sources.citation_text: The scholarly review summarizes Pyrrhus's invasion of Macedonia in 288 BCE and his loss of the kingdom to Lysimachus around 285 BCE.
